opinion_id.description: ID of the opinion to read.

recap_document_id.description: ID of the RECAP document to read.

cluster_id.description: ID of an opinion cluster (the `cluster_id` in search results).  Reads the case's main opinion; every opinion in the cluster (with type and author) is listed in `cluster_opinions`, so concurrences and dissents can be read by `opinion_id`.

chunk_index.description: 0-based index (or list of indexes) of the chunk(s) to return.  Omit to receive the full document text.

chunk_size.description: Characters per chunk (default 8000). Only relevant when chunk_index is supplied.
